steps.name: Interpretar
steps.task: Describe how the request is understood and the plan of action.

steps.name: Escolher especialistas
steps.task: Name the specialists needed (trader-analyst, trader-strategist, trader-hunter) and write the full prompt each will receive.

steps.name: Aprovação
steps.task: Show the plan and the prompts, and wait for an explicit yes before invoking any specialist. Quote the user's exact words in "userWords". Never infer a yes.

steps.name: Delegar
steps.task: Invoke each specialist through its own flow and collect its run id and result.

steps.name: Crítica
steps.task: Check every result: numbers make sense, every quote has a link and a timestamp, the specialist validated the worker. Send back anything weak.

steps.name: Entregar
steps.task: Give the user only the final, verified result.
